records.jp: そこは推理小説のコーナーか。<CR>よく読むの？
records.en_original: The mystery section, huh? Do you read this kind of thing a lot?
records.en_auxiliary: The mystery section, huh? Do you read this kind of thing a lot?
records.en: The mystery section, huh? Do you read this<CR>kind of thing a lot?

records.jp: わりと
records.en_original: I suppose.
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose.
records.en: I suppose.

records.jp: そういうのってさ、ものによっては<CR>怖いシーンあったりするけど、平気なの？
records.en_original: Some of these are actually pretty creepy, right? Don't you get scared?
records.en_auxiliary: Some of these are actually pretty creepy, right? Don't you get scared?
records.en: Some of these are actually pretty<CR>creepy, right? Don't you get scared?

records.jp: 平気
records.en_original: No.
records.en_auxiliary: No.
records.en: No.

records.jp: なんで？
records.en_original: How come?
records.en_auxiliary: How come?
records.en: How come?

records.jp: 必ず最後にネタばらしがあるから
records.en_original: Because they always solve the mystery in the end.
records.en_auxiliary: Because they always solve the mystery in the end.
records.en: Because there is always a reveal at the end.

records.jp: 推理小説の中の怖いシーンには意味があって、<CR>トリックもあるでしょ？
records.en_original: The scary scenes always play into the mystery. They're there for a reason.
records.en_auxiliary: The scary scenes always play into the mystery. They're there for a reason.
records.en: The frightening scenes in a mystery novel have a purpose,<CR>and there is a trick behind them, right?

records.jp: だから安心して読めるの
records.en_original: Once you've figured that out, then there's nothing to be afraid of.
records.en_auxiliary: Once you've figured that out, then there's nothing to be afraid of.
records.en: That is why I can read them without worry.

records.jp: なるほどー
records.en_original: I gotcha.
records.en_auxiliary: I gotcha.
records.en: I gotcha.

records.jp: （伶那さんがホラー苦手な理由もわかった気がする）
records.en_original: (I think I'm starting to get an idea of why Rena hates horror so much.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I think I'm starting to get an idea of why Rena hates horror so much.)
records.en: (I think I'm starting to get an idea of why Rena-san hates horror so much.)

records.jp: じゃ、これは？
records.en_original: How about this one?
records.en_auxiliary: How about this one?
records.en: How about this one?

records.jp: 読んだことある
records.en_original: I've read it already.
records.en_auxiliary: I've read it already.
records.en: I've read it already.

records.jp: お、マジで？　<CR>じゃあ、同じ作者のこっちは……
records.en_original: Huh? Really? What about this one by the same author?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Really? What about this one by the same author?
records.en: Oh, really?<CR>Then what about this one by the same author...?

records.jp: いい。怖……いや、私には合わなかった
records.en_original: No thanks. That one was too scar— ...I couldn't get through it.
records.en_auxiliary: No thanks. That one was too scar— ...I couldn't get through it.
records.en: No. It was scar... No, it did not suit me.

records.jp: （ホラーっぽすぎるのはダメなのか）
records.en_original: (Looks like she doesn't like anything too close to horror.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Looks like she doesn't like anything too close to horror.)
records.en: (Looks like she doesn't like anything too close to horror.)

records.jp: 星崎さんは普段何を読んでるの？
records.en_original: What do you usually read, Hoshizaki?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you usually read, Hoshizaki?
records.en: What do you usually read, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: 私は結構ラノベとか好きで……<CR>これとか結構おすすめ
records.en_original: I'm really into YA novels. I super recommend this one.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm really into YA novels. I super recommend this one.
records.en: I am pretty fond of light novels...<CR>I really recommend this one.

records.jp: ふーん
records.en_original: Huh.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh.
records.en: Huh.

records.jp: 伶那さんはこういうの読む？
records.en_original: Do you read this kind of stuff at all?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you read this kind of stuff at all?
records.en: Do you read this kind of thing, Rena-san?

records.jp: 全然
records.en_original: No.
records.en_auxiliary: No.
records.en: No.

records.jp: だったらちょっと抵抗あるかもしれないけど、<CR>気が向いたら読んでみて。本当に面白いから
records.en_original: You should give it a try if you're ever interested! I promise, it's so good.
records.en_auxiliary: You should give it a try if you're ever interested! I promise, it's so good.
records.en: Then you may be a little resistant to it,<CR>but try it if you ever feel like it. It is genuinely interesting.

records.jp: これとかいいよ。純文学っていうの？<CR>やっぱ教養が身に着くっていうか？
records.en_original: This kind of thing. I think you'd call it literary fiction? You know, real educational stuff.
records.en_auxiliary: This kind of thing. I think you'd call it literary fiction? You know, real educational stuff.
records.en: Something like this is good. Is it called literary fiction?<CR>It feels like it would broaden your education, I suppose?

records.jp: 教養って、どの分野の？
records.en_original: Educational? In what field?
records.en_auxiliary: Educational? In what field?
records.en: Educational? In what field?

records.jp: えーと、えーと、難しい言葉とか
records.en_original: The field of, uh, knowing...words.
records.en_auxiliary: The field of, uh, knowing...words.
records.en: The field of, uh, knowing...words.

records.jp: その返答が教養ないんだけど
records.en_original: Yes. I can see that.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. I can see that.
records.en: Yes. I can see that.

records.jp: ごめんなさい。本当はこういうラノベとか読んでる。<CR>でもこっちはこっちで違う方面の教養身につくよ
records.en_original: Sorry. I lied. I really only read YA novels. But I think they can be pretty educational in their own right.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry. I lied. I really only read YA novels. But I think they can be pretty educational in their own right.
records.en: Sorry. I actually read light novels like these.<CR>But these can teach you things in a different area too.

records.jp: 伶那さーん、そろそろ帰ろう
records.en_original: Rena! Let's head home soon.
records.en_auxiliary: Rena! Let's head home soon.
records.en: Rena! Let's head home soon.

records.jp: あ、ごめん。区切り悪かった？
records.en_original: Ah, sorry. Not at a good stopping point?
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, sorry. Not at a good stopping point?
records.en: Ah, sorry. Not at a good stopping point?

records.jp: べ、別に
records.en_original: I-it's fine.
records.en_auxiliary: I-it's fine.
records.en: I-it's fine.

records.jp: （伶那さんが持ってるの、ラノベ？）
records.en_original: (Is that a YA novel she's holding?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Is that a YA novel she's holding?)
records.en: (Is that a light novel Rena-san is holding?)

records.jp: もしかして、ラノベ興味ある？
records.en_original: Are you...interested in YA novels?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you...interested in YA novels?
records.en: Are you perhaps interested in light novels?

records.jp: あなたがしつこくすすめてきたから
records.en_original: Only because you wouldn't shut up about them.
records.en_auxiliary: Only because you wouldn't shut up about them.
records.en: Only because you wouldn't shut up about them.

records.jp: （そんなにしつこくすすめたっけ？）
records.en_original: (Was I that annoying?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Was I that annoying?)
records.en: (Was I that annoying?)

records.jp: それ、借りてくの？
records.en_original: Are you checking out that one?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you checking out that one?
records.en: Are you checking out that one?

records.jp: ま、まぁ、せっかく読み始めたし、<CR>一応最後まで読もうかな
records.en_original: W-well I've already started reading, so I might as well go ahead and finish it.
records.en_auxiliary: W-well I've already started reading, so I might as well go ahead and finish it.
records.en: W-well I've already started reading, so I might<CR>as well go ahead and finish it.

records.jp: 途中でやめるのは気持ち悪いから。こういうジャンルを<CR>読むのも勉強になるかもしれないし
records.en_original: Once I start something, I like to finish it. I may learn something from it if I'm lucky.
records.en_auxiliary: Once I start something, I like to finish it. I may learn something from it if I'm lucky.
records.en: Stopping halfway would feel wrong.<CR>Reading a genre like this may be educational too.

records.jp: （なんかいつもより口数多いな。<CR>でも伶那さんの好みに合ったみたいでよかった）
records.en_original: (She sure is talkative. I'm glad we seem to have similar tastes.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She sure is talkative. I'm glad we seem to have similar tastes.)
records.en: (She's more talkative than usual.<CR>But I'm glad it seems to suit Rena-san's tastes.)

records.jp: 面白いよね、それ
records.en_original: That one's good, isn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: That one's good, isn't it?
records.en: That one's good, isn't it?

records.jp: そうね、切り口とか。<CR>よくある異世界系とは違……
records.en_original: Yes, it has an interesting perspective. It's quite different from other—
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, it has an interesting perspective. It's quite different from other—
records.en: Yes, the approach, for one.<CR>It is different from the usual isekai—

records.jp: さっさと移動しましょ
records.en_original: Let's take this conversation somewhere else, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Let's take this conversation somewhere else, huh?
records.en: Let us get moving already.

records.jp: ？　うん
records.en_original: Hm? O-okay.
records.en_auxiliary: Hm? O-okay.
records.en: Hm? O-okay.
